ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of the jellyfish life cycle, with an adult jellyfish at the top, a segmented, budding-like polyp stage on the right/right lower side, and an arrow from this stage pointing to a small, free-swimming juvenile jellyfish form, then continuing to point to the adult jellyfish at the top. Reasoning: The question asks about the stage between the budding polyp and the adult jellyfish. According to jellyfish developmental terminology, this juvenile jellyfish stage located between the two is called ephyra.
